LESSON: HEALTHY HABITS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Health Practices
Topic 1.1: Healthy habits

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Healthy habits. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do we practice practicing health habits adequate sleep and rest, physical health habits?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. practise health habits that elements. promote wellbeing,  Learners state the importance of

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HEALTHY HABITS
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Healthy habits helps you succeed in HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: HEALTHY HABITS
Study Healthy habits like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Practise health habits that elements. promote wellbeing,  Learners state the importance of

What this means
In this part you learn to practise health habits that elements. promote wellbeing,  Learners state the importance of. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise health habits that elements. promote wellbeing,  Learners state the importance of.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Healthy habits” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise health habits that elements. promote wellbeing,  Learners state the importance of. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Healthy habits is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Healthy habits” around your school. (skill: practise health habits that elements. promote wellbeing,  Learners state the importance of)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Healthy habits to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: practise health habits that elements. promote wellbeing,  Learners state the importance of.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Healthy habits from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Healthy habits: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Healthy habits?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we practice practicing health habits adequate sleep and rest, physical health habits?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Healthy habits means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: practise health habits that elements. promote wellbeing,  Learners state the importance of.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
